note: frames[res][key] = [sheet index, x, y, w, h, anchorX, anchorY]. Draw so that (x + anchorX, y + anchorY) lands on the unit position. Sheets with mask: the mask for a frame is at the same x and y + maskOffsetY. Team colour (linear light): out = toSRGB(toLinear(base) + toLinear(mask.r) * toLinear(paint) + toLinear(mask.g) * toLinear(light)).
